Todo bien como siempre, pero me sorprendió la app para pagar, no tuve que exhibir ni carnet, ni tarjeta de crédito, ni tarjeta serví club. Con tan solo leer el código QR, todo lo demás, puntos, descuentos, todo automático!!!... Rapidísimo!!!!... Felicitaciones!!!

(Translated by Google)
Everything was great as always, but I was surprised by the payment app. I didn't have to show my ID, credit card, or Servi Club card. Just by scanning the QR code, everything else—points, discounts—was automatic! So fast! Congratulations!
